name: robotregistryfoundation
description: Plugins for the robot-md ecosystem and adjacent developer tooling — declare robots with ROBOT.md, visualize project workflows, and expose work safely to agents.

plugins.name: robot-md
plugins.description: Bundles the using-robot-md skill and auto-registers the robot-md-mcp server. Reads ROBOT.md, exposes capabilities/safety/body as MCP resources, surfaces validate/render tools.

plugins.name: workflow-atlas
plugins.description: JSON-driven workflow visualization for any project. Scaffolds a single-page HTML atlas with Atlas (Cytoscape graph), Sprint Log (auto-generated from git + Claude session activity with token totals), and Forecast (Chart.js burn-down + predicted-spend). Slash commands: init, refresh, open, add-flow. Hostable view-only web mode for sharing.

plugins.name: market-validation
plugins.description: Validate whether there is a real market for a product idea: multi-angle web research with live-URL verification → cited evidence pack → Tufte HTML deck + PDF/PPTX → a build/integrate brief and an emitted workflow-atlas market map. Cross-listed from the founder-skills marketplace.

plugins.name: build-options
plugins.description: Decide what to build after a market is validated: divergent options → independent judge-panel weighted decision matrix → adversarial stress-test → a recommended build with kill criteria. Chains into the prd → tasks skills. Cross-listed from the founder-skills marketplace.
